/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('inputs/orf.annot.q1.fa').read_text().split('>',1)[1].split('\\n',1)[1].replace('\\n','').strip()
print(len(s))
for pos in [186,283,945,1064,1361,1335,341,1043,1114,1399]:
    if pos is not None:
        print(pos, '1-based codon:', s[pos-1:pos+2] if pos-1>=0 else '', '0-based start codon at', pos-1, s[pos-1:pos+2])
# Extract ORF4 nuc using 1-based inclusive 283..1335 and translate
region=s[282:1335]
print(len(region), region[:9], region[-3:], region[:3])
# standard translation check
code = {
'UUU':'F','UUC':'F','UUA':'L','UUG':'L','CUU':'L','CUC':'L','CUA':'L','CUG':'L',
'AUU':'I','AUC':'I','AUA':'I','AUG':'M','GUU':'V','GUC':'V','GUA':'V','GUG':'V',
'UCU':'S','UCC':'S','UCA':'S','UCG':'S','CCU':'P','CCC':'P','CCA':'P','CCG':'P',
'ACU':'T','ACC':'T','ACA':'T','ACG':'T','GCU':'A','GCC':'A','GCA':'A','GCG':'A',
'UAU':'Y','UAC':'Y','UAA':'*','UAG':'*','CAU':'H','CAC':'H','CAA':'Q','CAG':'Q',
'AAU':'N','AAC':'N','AAA':'K','AAG':'K','GAU':'D','GAC':'D','GAA':'E','GAG':'E',
'UGU':'C','UGC':'C','UGA':'*','UGG':'W','CGU':'R','CGC':'R','CGA':'R','CGG':'R',
'AGU':'S','AGC':'S','AGA':'R','AGG':'R','GGU':'G','GGC':'G','GGA':'G','GGG':'G'}
prot=''.join(code.get(region[i:i+3],'?') for i in range(0,len(region),3))
print(len(prot), prot[:20], prot[-20:], prot[-1], prot.count('*'))
PY"
